whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: SyncWatch is an educational project built as part of the 42 curriculum. This page explains what data is collected when you use the service, why, and how it is protected.

why.title: Why this data is collected
why.body: Only to make the service work: authenticating you, displaying your profile and relationships, running shared rooms and chat, and keeping your account secure. No data is sold, rented, or shared with advertising networks or third-party trackers.

externalSources.title: External video sources
externalSources.body: SyncWatch hosts no video itself: it queries Internet Archive and PeerTube, and your browser streams directly from those hosts. Your search terms are therefore sent to those services whenever you search, just like any site that calls a public API.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.before: The session token is kept in your browser's local storage (
cookies.after: ), not in a tracking cookie. A temporary, protected (HttpOnly) technical cookie is used only during sign-in via Google or GitHub to verify the request's origin; it is deleted right afterwards. No advertising or analytics cookie is used.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time (see Contact below).

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are hashed with Argon2, session tokens are hashed before storage, and traffic between your browser and the server is meant to be encrypted (HTTPS).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at the address below.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: This policy may evolve along with the project. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: To be completed with a contact address.

account.label: Account
account.text: username, email address, password (hashed with Argon2, never stored in plain text), avatar if you upload one.

oauth.label: Google or GitHub sign-in
oauth.text: the external account identifier and the email address verified by the provider, used only to create or link your SyncWatch account.

social.label: Social graph
social.text: your friends list, friend requests sent or received, your online status.

rooms.label: Watch rooms
rooms.text: the rooms you create or join, and the chat messages you send there (kept to display the room's history).

technical.label: Technical
technical.text: a session token (hashed in the database, never stored in plain text), and standard server technical logs (IP address, request timestamps) for security purposes.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: SyncWatch is an educational project built as part of the 42 curriculum. It lets several users watch legally-sourced content (Internet Archive, PeerTube) together in real time, with chat and a friends system. By creating an account, you agree to these terms.

account.title: User account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for actions taken from your account. The information provided at signup must be accurate.

allowedUse.title: Permitted use
items: Chat and rooms are for respectful use only: no harassment, hate speech, or illegal content.
SyncWatch hosts no copyrighted video content: only public-domain content (Internet Archive) or freely-licensed content (PeerTube) is accessible through the aggregator.
Any attempt to bypass the service's security measures is forbidden.

yourContent.title: Content you provide
yourContent.body: The avatar you upload remains your property; you grant SyncWatch the right to display it as part of the service. Messages sent in a room are kept to display that room's history and may be deleted along with the room.

availability.title: Service availability
availability.body: SyncWatch is an educational project, not a commercial service: no guarantee of continuous availability or absence of interruption is provided.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You may stop using the service and request deletion of your account at any time. Access to an account may be suspended in case of abusive use of the service or failure to comply with these terms.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”, in an educational context, without any warranty as to uninterrupted operation or the accuracy of content from third-party sources.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may evolve along with the project. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.
